pages.title: The Sealbreaker
pages.text:
**Goal:** beat this keeper and bring its relic home.\
You need its **Frayed Totem** after the unlock, used outside an arena. Mates within 32 blocks come with you.\
The Ward Circle: a stone sanctum of gold circles and nine glyph pillars with amethyst spires, a nine-sided dais of gold pegs at the centre.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
The Sealbreaker hides behind three active wards.\
The dais pegs light the order once per phase — watch first.\
Dispel the pillars in that order with an Ars dispel or any Sigil-strand item; a wrong one re-arms all three and the ward-glass bites.\
Three right and it is open for twelve seconds.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
Later phases shuffle the runes and add a decoy.\
**Check:** `/guardians status` lists this win, and you hold the Woven Relic.

pages.title: Frayed Totem
pages.text: Four Frayed Thread and four of the Strand's block around a Void Yarn.

pages.title: Woven Relic
pages.text: Sealmark: magic damage taken is cut by a fifth. Sealmark wards you, or a Clowder mate you look at, against one heavy hit.
